Test your app's purchases without a store: see what a tester bought, simulate renewals, expiry and
refunds, or start over.

Debug builds in development mode make the purchases with the test publishable key; they are test
purchases and never unlock production.

Usage:
  voidhash sandbox <command> [flags]

Commands:
  view          Show a person's simulated purchases and the access they grant.
  renew         Renew a person's simulated subscription for another period, as the store would.
  expire        End a person's simulated subscription now, as when it lapses in the store.
  grace-period  Put a person's simulated subscription in its three-day billing grace period, as
                after a failed renewal.
  refund        Refund a person's one-time simulated purchase; the access it granted ends.
  revoke        Revoke a person's simulated purchase or subscription, as when the store takes it
                back.
  reset         Delete every simulated purchase in the project, to start testing over.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash sandbox <command> --help' for more about a command.
